title: Preflight + Canary Evals and Auto-Rollback for Model Pin/Upgrade
creator: Maya Patel
description:
Goal: Prevent customer-facing regressions when a catalog model or customer-pinned model is upgraded by running automated evals at multiple stages (preflight, canary, post-rollout) and triggering an automated rollback or alert when quality thresholds fall below agreed tolerances.

Background: We have observed occasional quality regressions when pin upgrades occur (internal incidents and customer reports). Existing tickets (ENG-8742, PM-4123) focus on detect-and-halt during swaps, but we need a product-owned end-to-end flow that: 1) validates candidate model/config before accepting a pin change, 2) runs canary evaluations on a small percentage of live traffic, and 3) provides automated rollback and clear investigation artifacts if regressions are detected. This ticket defines the product requirements, acceptance criteria, and rollout plan for the automated eval gating and rollback policy.

Proposal summary:
- Preflight (blocking check): When a model version is pinned/upgraded in the catalog or by a customer, the system launches a preflight eval suite against the pinned model/version using the owner-provided golden prompt set and Redwood canonical evals. The preflight must complete within a configurable timeout (default 30 minutes) and compare a set of quality metrics (exact-match, BLEU, n-ll, hallucination-rate, classification accuracy for labeled sets) against a baseline.
- Canary (live validation): If preflight passes, route X% of live requests (default 1%) to the new variant for Y minutes (default 30m) and run streaming evals on matched traffic and synthetic probes. Summaries are compared to production baseline with both statistical and practical significance tests.
- Automatic rollback: If any of the configured gating rules fail (e.g., quality delta > threshold OR increase in safety flags OR latency degradation above SLA), trigger a policy: either automatic rollback to prior model version (for P0 policies) or immediate pause + alert for manual rollback (for P1). Policies are configurable per-catalog and per-customer.

Acceptance criteria:
1) Product API: UI/CLI/API to opt into preflight and canary gating for catalog models and for customer-managed pins; default enabled for catalog-critical tiers.
2) Eval infra: Preflight and canary eval runs are scheduled and results stored in the evals service; each run includes evaluation artifacts (prompt samples, outputs, metric diffs) and a linkable report.
3) Gating engine: Definitions for gating rules (metric name, comparator, threshold, window, severity) and policy actions (rollback, pause, alert) can be created and applied to model pins.
4) Rollback mechanics: Automated rollback executes a safe rollback path that preserves in-flight requests and emits a rollback event with justification and reproducible artifacts for RCA.
5) Observability: Dashboard showing active pin changes, preflight status, canary health, and rollback history; alerting hooks to Slack/PagerDuty with runbook links.
6) Performance: Preflight/Canary eval overhead must not exceed defined cost envelope (<= 2% added infra cost for canary at default settings) and preflight timeouts configurable per-catalog.
7) Security & Data: All eval data respects customer data retention/KMS settings and does not leak private prompts to other customers.

Rollout plan:
- Phase 1 (beta, 2-4 weeks): Implement preflight for catalog-managed model upgrades only, with UI to start the check and view reports. Invite 3 pilot customers.
- Phase 2 (6 weeks): Add canary routing + live evals and basic auto-rollback policy for high-risk models. Expand pilot.
- Phase 3 (Q2): Enable opt-in for customer-managed pins, policy templates, and guardrails (cost caps, safety review required).

Risks & open questions:
- Definition of baseline for models without historical evals; need canonical baseline heuristics.
- Threshold tuning: actioning too aggressively may cause churn; recommend conservative defaults and learning loop.
- Cost: live canaries increase token consumption; require billing treatment and budget controls.

Next steps:
- Finalize gating rule schema with Eng and Evals team (design doc link below).
- Build PRD and wireframes for Console integration.
- Coordinate with Security for eval artifact storage policy.
